items.headline: Solana Perp Volume Explodes 65% as Spot Fades
items.summary: $SOL perpetual futures volume surged 65% even as spot activity contracted, signaling leveraged traders are piling into Solana.

items.headline: LlamaRisk Proposes $1.33B Collateral Exit From $AAVE
items.summary: LlamaRisk wants to pull $1.33B in collateral from Aave Core, a major governance shake-up that could reshape $AAVE's risk framework.

items.headline: $SEI Holders Unanimously Approve SIP-6 Autobahn Upgrade
items.summary: Sei Network's SIP-6 Autobahn upgrade passed with zero votes against, setting up a major performance overhaul for $SEI.

items.headline: $TAO Gains After Tencent AI Launch, Subnet Fees in Focus
